unit: U2 performance + SCION #32 Forward Kinematics (#48 state machine, #41 secondary dynamics as methods)
inputs: test-shot-build/shot.py (approved r2 card primitives, planes, shoe cut)
U1 world planes: not yet available (sources/.../world/ held only look/); rendered over the approved test-shot planes

code.run: cd films/swarm/la-mort-en-ce-jardin/performance && python3 -I rig.py && python3 -I gate.py && python3 -I gate.py --counterexamples && python3 -I render_ls5.py && python3 -I sheet.py

rig.units: world px (wide-shot picture px at puppet scale s=1)
rig.angle_convention: absolute bone angles in degrees, screen coordinates (0 = +x, 90 = down); local = abs(child) - abs(parent)

bag.note: strap hangs from the hand-bone end

shoe.note: heel in the palm, rotates with the hand bone

rig.quantisation: time floor to 1/12 s, angles rounded to whole degrees
invariants: bone length |L - L0*s| < 0.5 px every frame
child pivot on parent end < 0.5 px (no head/neck detachment)
props drawn from the holder's hand bone only

pose_keys.rate: 12 poses/s (on twos), angles whole degrees, smoothstep eased between authored keys (walks keyed every 1/12 s, linear)

shots.L-S1/E-S1: standing queue A 150, B 100 (bag L hand), C 40
shots.L-S2/E-S2: A crouch-write keys 3.0-5.6 at x 120 (pencil hand travels 50 px)
shots.L-S3: A walk on the plank 6.0-12.5, x 160->740, hip solved from the lower boot on the deflecting plank (hip drop at double support), left hand on the liana
shots.L-S4: B steps to the plank head 8.0-9.5; head turns 14.25-17.0 in 12 fps steps; C head turn at 15.5-16.0 (« Laisse-la. »)
shots.L-S5 (test shot): shared retrieval keys T0=18.4: -0.40 sees, 0.00 pushes bag back (B.L->C.R), +0.40 lowers, +0.85 kneels/reaches, +1.20 grasps (shoe water->B.R), +1.70 rises, +2.20/+2.60 shoe held out at chest height, free hand up toward the liana; C receive keys -0.60..+2.60 (bag to chest, then held high)

shots.L-S8: B crosses 30.0-35.0 liana + shoe at chest

shots.E-S6: B crosses 15.0-19.5 (shoe), A 19.8-24.4 (bag high), C 24.8-29.4 (free hand)

checks: G2 <= 2 grips per person; plank occupant has exactly one hand on the liana
G3 one holder per object (bag always; shoe once it appears; no vanishing)
G4 holder changes only at logged handoff/retrieve/hand_swap (+-1 frame), hands (or shoe and hand) within 40 px
G5 FK recomputed from stored root + whole-degree angles: bone length / pivot error < 0.5 px; stored hand points agree
G6 bag bottom above the water while over the channel

notes_for_editor: Close shots are camera reframings of the world trace: call rig.sample(poses[v][who], t) -> fk() -> camera map (render_ls5.to_screen); never re-pose in screen space.

E-S4 = render_ls5.frame with POSES/TRACE switched to E and T_START 10.5 (same keys shifted -7.0 s). The water level differs 4.5 px between L and E at the grasp, so the shoe's resting y differs by that amount (U3's byte-identical shoe layer must be placed relative to the plank foot, not to the water line, or accept the small difference).
Shoe drift before arrival here is an approximation (shoe_world in rig.py); U3's SHOE-DRIFT-1 is canonical; arrival/tap 3.6 s after first appearance (L 17.6, E 10.6) and grasp 2.0 s after the tap.
Water level offsets were calibrated so the last crosser's min clearance is exactly 4 px (L, B) and 6 px (E, C); see rig.json world.water_offset_px.
Bag is held high (hand above the head) on every crossing; bag_bottom_y is logged per frame.
